'''Terran Endo Ops w/ That Things Operational''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Terran]]
* '''Published:''' 22 February 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat EOps Terran DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a Endor Ops deck that can use that thing's operational. I have been quite successful with it so far, but I am still hunting for cards to make it better (mostly characters) Any advice or comments would be quite appreciated.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

The is that I have two options. This Deck can be played two ways.  If I feel it is a better idea in a particular game to play space, than I deploy on Endor and use Ominous Rumours.  If I think it is a better Idea to invade the opponent’s sites, I use That Things Operational and swarm.
